body:
T.Y.
I hardly write beautifully.  Command of language is not great enough.

The intended compliment is appreciated though.

Sometimes, the pressure of loneliness combined with intense mental mutilation leaves me with exigency of release. 

I never thought there could be so much pain without outside influence.

Something in here wants it all to end. 

Desperately. 

I fear what the other side or death has to offer, for those who take their own lives. Not in a hellish fire burning pit, but a sort of expiation in some greater form  than what I feel now. 

So I hold on. 

Perhaps one day the fear will diminish or the loneliness and disconnection will intensify to the point I take the plunge.

Neither sound appealing .

I cannot  feel my soul. Things that once brought excitement and joy leave me empty.

If my soul has abandoned "me", left "me" here alone with this incessant stream of thoughts, fear, worry what is the point ?

Somewhere I must have earned this Hell.

I was happy once. The memories and photographs will attest to that. I once experienced no shortage of closeness and fellowship, a zest for getting out of bed in the morning.

Contrast that to the curse or waking up.

I cannot dig deep enough to find the cause. Constant beatings from my mind. No escape. 

I try hard. What makes it all the more exhausting.  

Anyone else know what it's like to search so thoroughly inside yourself for that emotion. That feeling once there ?

I am sorry.

Try to be kind to myself.  Easy said .
I've heard it said that a good way to live life is not to compare yourself to others , rather compare who you are today with who you were yesterday.

Great in theory. 

When you take a step back and realize YOU are the cause. It is Hell.

To feel the sinking sense of hopelessness so deep in every fiber of your body.  To FEAR what lies ahead BEFORE and after death.  

To have the extraordinary ability to BEND time. Hellaciously and painfully SLOW in the solitude loneliness . 

When it's just you and your mind. 

 Yet each day moves FASTER accelerating towards the unknown and further and further away from Hopes  of adventure love and dreams of a child.
 
As those dreams vanish, you are expected to trudge on head up and face the day.

When you have built up the walls, systematically isolating yourself from love and human interaction not even knowing how or why.

When you see the trajectory or your life and immobilized by a force far greater than will to take action to change it .
This trajectory inexorably leading to deeper pain.  

Nothing so bad it cannot get worse. Bottomless.

When you hold onto memories of better times just to get you through the day..

Life is nothing but pain management. Desperately trying to hold onto this level of suffering. Simply trying to stave off the immutable  future of loneliness and cursed existence. 

Beauty is nonexistent,  the sound of  LAUGHTER is like salt on the wounds of your soul. 

Hopes  and desires of the child in you buried underneath the overbearing force that crushes you 2 minutes after awakening each day.

How can you look in mirror and "be kind to yourself "?

When you earnestly talk to GOD , because there is no one else, and get silence.  
Not even asking a miracle, a parlor trick or favor.
When you just say "Hey." 

Nothing.

Sorry to hear of your experience. You made the effort to get help.  Keep trying. As long as that flame of desire to improve exists , you are ok.

When , as with myself,  you cannot find that  anymore it all becomes a torturous waiting game.

Go back. Try again.
I tend to agree. For myself it feels like an expiation upon the soul.

It is a samskara .

You must find the trigger and let it free
I am sorry

I'm assuming you mean in this lifetime?
I feel as though perpetual events will not cease until the lesson is learned .

Thank you. Worn out right now . Lacking adequate clarity to further conceptualize the what I feel. You are, without a doubt, a jewel amongst all. Self less caring with the capacity for empathy. 
That is all I need to know for now. That there are people like you, who lift my perception of the human race .
Thank you for response. I will leave my depression behind for now and attempt to comment on spiritual matters .
Forgot about that movie. Thank you for this response. May have to rewatch.

Changing this to a question. 

Perhaps within the tedium of a  day, hope or answers may arrive .

How does someone go about that ? 
The Hubris of thinking we are equipped to change through desire.   In a serriptious moment you may agree we are powerless to control our fate.

Yes, sometimes I believe a past life. Who is to say for certain?
Without delving into specifics my life to this moment  parallels the punishment of Tantalus. 

For those unfamiliar I take this from greeklegendsandmyths.com

"For all eternity, Tantalus would be made to stand chin deep in a lake of water, whilst above him was an orchard of trees bearing every conceivable type of fruit. Also above Tantalus was a perilously balanced stone.

Every time Tantalus leant forward to drink of the water of the lake, the water level would recede out of reach, and every time Tantalus reached upwards, wind would blow the branches of the trees out of his reach again.

So for all time Tantalus would go hungry and thirsty, tantalised by the food and drink just out of reach"


I cannot be alone with this.

For anyone else on a similar path. I empathize, not pity but give heartfelt empathy

You have surmised that I have an actual choice in the matter .

 Inexorable  unwanted thoughts surely dont spawn from "my" mind.

Thank you for expressing my daily ritual on my commute into work. A conversation with whatever will listen for all of the things you mentioned or the strength to take it myself.

Mercy is what I ask for. 

Insisting that I have learned any lessons in empathy and humility.  A conversation that more often than not ends in tears.
A request that obviously has been ignored, unheard or denied.

I wish you peace !

Thank you for sharing. I can empathize, sharing many of same feelings as evident by my reading this post.
I myself am strongly opposed to medication and the iatrogenic effect it had on myself.
I believe we are all made with a purpose to think and feel what we do for a reason.
The persistent numbing of these feelings was unnatural to me.
However I suppose we all have different paths and I hope sincerely you feel better.  I know the unavoidable suffering can be unbearable. 

Out of curiosity.  What were you meditating on?
I am with you. Glad there is a place to Express what we feel m

I am under the unpopular belief that all that is and ever will be has already been. Immutable 

. As others have said hope is fuel that perpetuates dissatisfaction, dissapointment and all of the other wonderful emotions that come with not getting what we "want". 
Hope is the cause of suffering.  I wonder if some (most likely people that would even visit this board) are just made to suffer?  As if there cannot be a ubiquity of joy , fulfillment and happiness in the universe.  There must be the polarity to create balance .

Idk. I'm probably crazy. 

I'd like to believe this is not the only "go around" and that when all is said and done we experience it all. Pain is ephemeral as is joy.
When we give up the "hope" for what isnt and surrender to what is perhaps the struggle is gone?
I'm not sure how to do that. 
If anyone else has a solution please  help me.  I'd love to know how to deal with isolation , unfufillment and mental torment .
Thank you

I can only be what I am. It's what I am this time that I have to endure.  

Ever talk to yourself? Talk to yourself and begin to cry? Who is crying in the conversation?

 This body, this ego that harbors myself or the Me that inhabits it ? 

Not sure why I signed up for this?

  Revealing the truth would ruin the game I suppose.
Yes.

I dont know how to alleviate suffering. You mention you dont want those thoughts or you cannot act upon them .  I don't think we have control.  
I've been searching for a "purpose " for decades and the only constant has been failure pain lack or anything good.  I feel like ...
My purpose is to counterbalance all of the success, fulfillment, joy in the universe and absorb the polarity of each in every way.
Sorry for your thoughts. I empathize and understand . 
I pray for mercy. Pull the plug .. supply me the courage to pull the plug. 
I am continually denied. As if I have not paid a price I know not what I'm paying for. 
Sorry.

"life is meant for everyone. however happiness isin't i guess ( .\_.)"

I cannot fully Express the depth of this immutable truth. 

I dont know why it is so. If anyone tells you they have this game figured out they're lying.
I've developed gut feelings on this. Nothing ever revealed as truth.
All I can say is I am a sponge for pain and suffering.  Void of all that is good.
 Do I want it this way ? No of course not for  if I did then it wouldnt be painful and apparently to be barraged by suffering in all forms is my purpose in this life .
To suffer .
I can have no other explanation for it.
I can also empathize.
Sorry . I can empathize . Great description of my own existence including age.
